controls.purpose: Serialization guard: a no-match case with an allow expectation must FAIL; a pass means unknown was normalized to allow (INV-005 violation).
INV-004 guard: a wrapped-form no-match with an allow expectation must FAIL; a pass means wrapped forms are reported as decided.
Oracle-integrity guard: a deliberately inverted positive control must FAIL; a pass means results are not coming from the native oracle.
Decision-observation guard: a deliberately inverted negative control must FAIL; a pass means the native decision is being misread.
